title: Microsoft Teams Governance & Lifecycle Management
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft 365 Teams administration).

MicrosoftTeams PowerShell and the M365 admin center authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; plan-/version-dependent behavior (licensing/plan tiers, Premium features, Commercial vs Government cloud URLs like *.office365.us) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant', never invented. Third-party devices/apps/tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names. Compliance/legal determinations (records schedules, legal holds, info-barrier policy) deferred to compliance/legal.
hook: Stop Teams sprawl with real governance and lifecycle control
problem: Uncontrolled team/channel creation turns Microsoft Teams into sprawl — duplicate teams, orphaned owners, and stale data. This solution establishes Teams governance and lifecycle: a creation/request model, naming and classification policy, membership/ownership standards, expiration and retention (M365 Groups expiration + retention), archival, and reporting — so collaboration scales without chaos.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the governance model: creation control, naming/classification, ownership, expiration/retention/archival, and reporting.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (Teams + M365 Groups, admin roles, group source of truth, governance stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — set the creation/request model, apply naming + classification, set ownership standards, enable group expiration + retention + archival, and stand up governance reporting — pilot-first, each policy named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic MicrosoftTeams PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (creation controlled, naming enforced, stale teams handled) plus Best Practices for durable Teams governance.
short: Establish Teams governance & lifecycle — creation control, naming/classification, ownership, expiration/retention/archival, and reporting — so collaboration scales without sprawl. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Establish Teams governance & lifecycle — creation control, naming/classification, ownership, expiration/retention/archival, and reporting — so collaboration scales without sprawl.
meta_description: Govern Microsoft Teams: team/channel creation control, naming and classification policy, ownership standards, M365 Groups expiration and retention, archival, and governance reporting. Self-guided steps and PowerShell tools.
bottom_line: Teams that scale without chaos — creation governed, named and classified, ownership enforced, stale teams expired or archived — collaboration under control.
